critical_code_review_comments: server.py has now grown to 944 lines — mixing quotes, admin pw, leads proxy, sheets, cleaners, assignments, site images, PWA, settings. Extracting routes/assignments.py + routes/admin_auth.py would reduce cognitive load and make the file navigable. Same recommendation as iter 7-9 (carry-over).

backend/server.py:224 ADMIN_PW_CACHE is process-local. Under multiple worker processes (gunicorn/uvicorn with --workers>1) a password change only invalidates the worker that served the PUT — other workers keep serving with the stale cached pw until _load_admin_password is called again. The startup hook loads it, but no per-request refresh. Recommend either (a) reading db.app_settings on every _check_admin (small perf cost, single-doc query) or (b) publishing a Mongo change-stream notification. Not a bug today (single worker) but a foot-gun once scaled.

backend/server.py:271 /api/leads proxy uses `requests.get` sync-wrapped via run_in_threadpool — fine for the current 15s timeout but no retries and no caching. If bookmycleaning.xyz has a slow spike the whole admin Leads tab hangs. Consider a small 30s in-memory TTL cache since polling is 30s anyway.

backend/server.py:892 POST /assignments/{id}/status — no admin auth path, only cleaner PIN. This is fine for cleaners self-updating, but if PIN is compromised, a bad actor could flip 'done' on ANY assignment (needs to know the id + cleaner_id, so partial protection). Consider also allowing admin auth as an alternative and/or logging status transitions.

backend/server.py:895 the string tuple ('on_the_way','cleaning','done') is duplicated with the frontend STATUS_META keys — consider a shared enum in a constants file. Same drift risk on jobs filter $in list at line 881.

frontend admin.js:37 DailySummary — activeJobs filter is `STATUS_META[a.status]` which covers assigned/on_the_way/cleaning. If a new status is added later (e.g., 'paused'), it silently disappears from the Active count. Consider `!== 'done'` as the criterion so unknown statuses are counted as active by default.
frontend cleaner.js:14 JOB_STEPS is defined but not exported. If the cleaner card is refactored into a component, this const needs to move to a shared constants file.

frontend AdminBusiness.js:247-249 the password fields don't clear after successful save. Not a bug, but leaving the new/confirm fields populated after a successful change gives users the false impression they'd have to change it back. Consider setNewPw('')+setConfirmPw('') on success.

frontend AdminBusiness.js there is no way to view the current password (obvious for security) but also no way to test that the local pw matches the production pw — a user who has diverged the local pw from production will silently break assign/lead operations if the proxy relay ever falls back to production pw. Consider a small 'test password' button or health indicator.

frontend admin.js the 30s assignment poll refreshes assignments but doesn't refresh leads. If a lead is deleted on production between polls, it will still appear until the next full leads fetch. Consider polling both together or documenting the invariant.

backend PRODUCTION_ADMIN_PASSWORD in /app/backend/.env is a plaintext copy of the local admin pw — this is fine for dev, but keep in mind that changing the local pw in the DB does NOT change what the proxy sends to production (proxy always uses env). Documented behavior but worth a code comment.
